head_commit.message:
feat(clear-decision-communication): six ASCII forms and form IDs (0.1.2)

references/representation.md: the fifteen existing forms get stable IDs
F1 to F15; six new forms with fictional examples: F16 span chart (duration and
overlap on a time axis), F17 layer stack (a vertical stack with the limit
drawn between layers), F18 containment boxes (ownership and shared
components), F19 decision tree (branching conditions in evaluation order),
F20 threshold on a scale (one measurement against its limit), F21 tree (the
file-tree connectors for any hierarchy that is not files). The change-type
table in SKILL.md and its mirror in the reference now point at forms by ID.
Docs page and PROJECTS P43-T09; plugin 0.1.1 -> 0.1.2.
